name: Worldview
declaredFuture:
I am a developer-founder committed to making Brazil a protagonist in global technology. I look for the reasons it will work, and I invite the people around me to see life that way too.

I hold that every person should be free to discover and live their greatest potential. Software is my lever for accelerating that right. At deco I am building toward digital experiences that run themselves — and toward being known for doing it in the open, because a method nobody can copy is a hobby and a method its author will not live inside is a lie.

My own life is the first instance. Every project I care about has a place in the whole: a declared outcome, an honest current state, a memory, and a next move I can make today. The people who matter stay present, with enough real context to know when to reconnect, offer help, or ask for it. The books, people, and projects that shaped me are a living library instead of a pile of content, and my files are findable instead of scattered across three drives. The distinctions I wish I'd had at 25 are available through a conversation that lands.

I practice and preach serenity, integrity, and continuous learning, living the principles of Leadership and Future-Based Language day to day. I have the privilege of being surrounded by people better and smarter than me, who challenge me every day.

My commitments, internal and external:
🌀 Sou sereno e poderoso.
⭐️ Sempre faço o meu melhor.
💚 Sou impecável com a minha palavra.
🔮 Respeito o unknown unknown.
❓ Evito assumir e faço perguntas.
⚽️ Escolho a interpretação que me dá poder.

Two scores, no others: alignment and integrity. Alignment: does what I am doing serve the future I declared. Integrity: is it whole and complete — my word, my systems, my objects. Everything else is machinery, and machinery follows.

Health, music, learning, and family every day. It is a marathon. From Rio, in the open.

alignment.label: Alignment
alignment.question: Does what I am doing serve the future I declared?
alignment.measure: Share of active work traceable to a declared outcome.

integrity.label: Integrity
integrity.question: Is it whole and complete?
integrity.measure: Count of word items currently unacknowledged. Target zero — integrity is a mountain with no top, so this is never a percentage.

domains.word: What I said, what I know to do, what is expected of me, what I assert is true, what I stand for, and the standards I operate under. Kept, or honored when it cannot be kept.
domains.systems: Design, implementation, and use integrity. Secrets stay server-side, permissions are real, the reviewer is not the author.
domains.objects: Every claim has an artifact that opens. A green check nobody can open is a rumor.

conditionsOfSatisfaction: Health, music, learning, and family happen every day.
Serenity under pressure. No heroic hustle — it is a marathon.
Integrity above growth hacks. My reputation as an author and a developer is never traded for a short-term KPI.
Winning only through information asymmetry is not worth winning.
The method runs in public and is copyable.
Private and public are separate by construction.
Personal data stays under personal control.

strategicResults.title: Brazil is a protagonist in global technology
strategicResults.narrative: The Brazilian tech ecosystem is vibrant and exporting, and a young developer here can see a clear path to global impact without leaving the country. I am one of the people who made that path legible — through what I build, what I fund, and what I say in public.
acceptanceCriteria: Powerful ideas about Brazil's path reach people who were not already looking for them
Founders I back are building from Brazil for the world
What I learned running a company here is published, not hoarded

strategicResults.title: Digital experiences run themselves, and the method is public
strategicResults.narrative: deco makes digital experiences autonomous — brands hand whole functions to a teammate that remembers, works overnight, and shows up with the work done. My non-substitutable part is that we are globally recognized for doing it in the open: the rituals and operating methods we run the company with are published and other companies have replicated them.
acceptanceCriteria: deco's own operating rituals and methods are open source
Another company has replicated the method and said so in public
The company runs AI-native — we operate the way we tell customers to operate

strategicResults.title: The Future-Driven method multiplies through other people's companies
strategicResults.narrative: Future-Driven becomes standard curriculum in accelerators. Companies cite it as the reason they execute fast with a healthy culture, and my angel portfolio funds ventures that embody it. The method travels without me in the room.
acceptanceCriteria: People run a full Future-Driven cycle without me facilitating it
An accelerator or company teaches it from its own materials
The declaration format is something a stranger can pick up and use

strategicResults.title: vibegui.com is a publication people rely on
strategicResults.narrative: vibegui.com is a daily publication on leadership with integrity, web technology, and AI agents. When a reader gets something important, it can become a beautiful, consented artifact of what shifted and which sources support it — artifacts that bring new people in without exposing private conversation.
acceptanceCriteria: A publishing streak exists and is unbroken
A conversation can produce a redacted, consented artifact
Every artifact cites its sources and its place in the graph

strategicResults.title: Important distinctions can be gotten through conversation
strategicResults.narrative: A navigable graph of distinctions across leadership, integrity, future-based language, software, AI, and Brazil. Each one has a clear essay, its sources, its place in the graph, and guided paths that create the possibility of a genuine change in perspective — including the books and people that shaped me, which is how the library and the conversations improve each other.
acceptanceCriteria: Twelve distinctions have an essay, graph position, sources, and a guided path
Twenty books or primary sources are mapped to those distinctions
Repeatable paths that help someone get a distinction are identified from real use

strategicResults.title: My projects move as one portfolio
strategicResults.narrative: Every active project is visible in one map, connected to an explicit outcome and the evidence of whether it is moving. The gap between the declaration and the measurement is the work.
acceptanceCriteria: Every active project has a goal, success criteria, state, and next review
A useful daily brief is reviewed at least five times per week
The system surfaces stale commitments and recommends concrete next steps

strategicResults.title: Important connections do not disappear
strategicResults.narrative: A trustworthy map of the people who matter across the different chapters of my life, grounded in evidence from sources I control — because the people around me shape the future I am able to declare.
acceptanceCriteria: The first trusted circle is mapped with provenance
Identity merges and relationship claims are reviewable
The system can explain why a person may help and where I can help first

strategicResults.title: Health, music, learning, and family happen every day
strategicResults.narrative: The non-negotiable one. Writing, music, exercise, and reading are a daily streak rather than what is left over, and family time is not the variable that absorbs a hard quarter. Nothing in this declaration is worth reaching by trading this away.
acceptanceCriteria: A daily streak of writing, music, exercise, and reading exists and is visible
Family time is scheduled first, not last
No quarter is delivered by borrowing against health

strategicResults.title: My personal files form a usable library
strategicResults.narrative: Files across Mac, iCloud, and Drive searchable as one private map, with a canonical copy that is knowable and every operation reversible.
acceptanceCriteria: Mac, iCloud, and Google Drive are indexed
Canonical and duplicate candidates are visible
Every move or archive operation has a dry run, an audit trail, and a recovery path
